Chapter 6438: Merciless Heaven

Chapter 6438: Merciless Heaven

Some praised Xianting as being more talented than Xian Chengtian. Unfortunately, numerous ancient ancestors ambushed and killed him.

This incited the wrath of Desolate Frontier who took down many of them. Supreme Black Ancestor became involved and personally suppressed Seventy-two Origin Ancestor, taking him to the eternal stage. His cultivation stagnated all this time, potentially due to the suppression.

Some believed he could have become a supreme ancestor. After all, he was guided by Moshi, not to mention being the second primal ancestor in history. The third primal ancestor was Staff who was now a supreme overlord.

Those on the side of Desolate Ancestor said he was fortunate for being alive. This was due to his parents’ connection with her faction.

Meanwhile, the spreading of his wings changed the shape of the dream world. Everyone thought each wing represented an azure.

“Desolate Frontier isn’t the same as before.” He uttered calmly yet each word could pierce the flesh. Listeners sensed his animosity and hatred.

His clan had an irreconcilable feud with Desolate Ancestor yet his parents sided with her. Once they died in battle, the elders of the clan banished him. The sudden drop from being the heaven’s favorite since birth to a wandering orphan traumatized him.

He experienced ordeals and the cruelty of this world; his rage toward Desolate Ancestor and her sect grew with time. Alas, he was powerless to act until a chance meeting with Moshi.

With Moshi’s guidance, his dao soared and he became a primal ancestor. He established a sect and embarked on the path of vengeance.

He could not do anything to the immortal but Desolate Frontier was a different story.

“Everlasting Jiang is dead, Tenth-gen Chen is dead, Desolate Frontier is finished.” He spoke.

“Bam!” His eternal aura assaulted the duo again.

The latter worked as a team to stop the incoming pressure.

Meanwhile, listeners were astounded by the news of Tenth-gen Chen’s death. This meant a significant drop in Desolate Frontier’s power.

The pillars included Everlasting Jiang, Tenth-gen Chen, and North Kun God. Now, two have fallen.

Desolate Frontier had prevented this information from leaking. Only a few outsiders knew of Tenth-gen Chen’s death; they were unaware of the reason. The sect considered the Chen’s conduct shameful.

The question in everyone’s mind was whether Desolate Frontier remained the number one sect in Old World.

“Desolate Frontier will exist long after your sect’s destruction.” Whale responded.

“Is that so? Let’s see how many more primal ancestors it can afford to lose then.” Seventy-two Origin Ancestor responded and channeled the divine light of the wings into his hand, twisting it into a wrathful spear.

“Crackle!” Lightning pulsed on the spear as he roared: “Tribulation Punish!”

As the lightning spear coursed through the air, everyone thought it could destroy all of Old World.

“Bring it!” Whale and Stoneboiler shouted.

“Immeasurable Heavenstone!” Stoneboiler recalled his dao to reach simplicity. He leaped into the air and turned into a divine mountain made of the heaviest and toughest metal. Power descended from above and empowered him.

“Whale Fall!” Whale leaped into the air as well, seemingly pulling up the dream world with him. When he descended with the force of countless stars, he could crush anything.

“Boom!” Alas, both were sent flying by the spear with blood streaming down from the corner of their lips.

“Merciless Heaven!” The origin ancestor gathered his wings and summoned numerous more spears.

Lightning illuminated all of the dream world and reached the real world as well. The explosions symbolized the heaven’s wrath.

All living beings shuddered before the incoming attack. Would the dream world be able to contain it?
